Event: Ecruteak Gym access before beast release
Gold / Silver: Gold/Silver: Morty's Gym has no Crystal-style forced-ejection scene.
Crystal: Crystal: the Gym has a forced-leave scene until the Burned Tower beast-release state advances.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS: the Gym header routes VAR_UNK_4079==0 to a forced-leave script; Burned Tower later advances the variable.
Integration decision: Preserve G/S progression freedom in the integrated build. Crystal/HGSS story state can naturally unlock the normal route, but beating Morty early must remain representable and later Burned Tower dialogue must adapt.

Gold / Silver: Fog Badge + TM30 Shadow Ball.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Fog Badge + ITEM_TM30.
Integration decision: Single shared reward state; no conflict.

Gold / Silver: Gen II invisible-path style Gym.
Crystal: Retains the Gen II puzzle family and adds the pre-beast-release ejection state.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Rebuilt with EcruteakGymInit/fall-reset handling.
Integration decision: Preserve the GSC puzzle as content; add the HGSS puzzle as a selectable/rebuilt map layer rather than deleting the original.

Gold / Silver: Normal route toward Route 39/Olivine with trainers and phone/side events.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same core story function; checked R38 script is minimal and does not add a new mandatory main-story branch.
Integration decision: Keep route progression unchanged; remake additions remain optional layers.

Gold / Silver: No Baoba/Safari Zone introduction.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Baoba stops the player on Route 39, explains his new Safari Zone project, registers his Pokégear number, and later calls when the facility opens.
Integration decision: Add as an HGSS side-story seed. It must not remove or overwrite Moomoo Farm or Route 39 legacy events.

Gold / Silver: Sick Miltank is healed by feeding seven Berries.
Crystal: Same seven-Berry progression, tracked by wMooMooBerries with milestones at 3, 5, and 7.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Uses seven Oran Berries; the script advances through seven explicit state flags before setting the healed flag.
Integration decision: Use one 0–7 healing counter. Legacy BERRY and Gen IV ORAN_BERRY remain separately documented official inputs; integrated acceptance of both is a project compatibility rule.

Gold / Silver: TM13 Snore after healing Miltank.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: TM83 Natural Gift after healing Miltank.
Integration decision: Do not replace TM13. Preserve TM13 Snore and add TM83 Natural Gift after Gen IV TM expansion, each with its own claimed flag.

Gold / Silver: Milk becomes available after Miltank recovery; price is ¥500.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Milk sales unlock after the healed state; script supports single and dozen purchase options.
Integration decision: Preserve the original ¥500 single sale and add HGSS bulk-purchase UI as an extension.

Gold / Silver: Jasmine is away at the Lighthouse until Amphy is healed.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Jasmine's Gym object is hidden until Lighthouse healing clears the hide flag.
Integration decision: Use one Jasmine-location state so the Lighthouse and Gym copies can never coexist.

Gold / Silver: Multi-floor trainer route to Jasmine and Amphy.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Expanded 3D lighthouse traversal while preserving the climb-to-Amphy story function.
Integration decision: Keep all GSC trainer/event content; remake map geometry is a separate map-backport layer.

Gold / Silver: At the top of the Lighthouse, Jasmine asks for medicine from Cianwood.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Uses VAR_SCENE_LIGHTHOUSE_JASMINE to stage the explanation and open the SecretPotion branch.
Integration decision: Keep the GSC story fact and use a dedicated scene variable for presentation.

Gold / Silver: Cianwood pharmacy gives the medicine only after Jasmine's request.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Pharmacy gives ITEM_SECRETPOTION only when the Lighthouse scene has reached the correct state; otherwise it behaves as a pharmacy.
Integration decision: One shared quest entitlement with source-specific presentation. Do not allow premature acquisition unless explicitly added as a project convenience rule.

Gold / Silver: Surf route from Olivine to Cianwood; Whirl Islands remain an optional branch for later conditions.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same main traversal role with remake map/content additions.
Integration decision: Preserve the open sea route and all swimmers. Do not force Whirl Islands into the medicine quest.

Gold / Silver: Optional/partially gated area, not required to obtain the SecretPotion.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Still separate from the basic Olivine→Cianwood medicine route; later SoulSilver mascot story uses it more heavily.
Integration decision: Keep medicine progression independent from the later mascot branch.

Gold / Silver: No Eusine-driven fixed Suicune scene in G/S.
Crystal: Suicune appears in Cianwood after the Burned Tower release and triggers the Eusine story.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: A dedicated Cianwood script shows Suicune, hides it, reveals Eusine, and starts the Eusine battle.
Integration decision: Use Crystal as the base narrative layer and HGSS choreography as the upgrade. This event is independent of Chuck victory.

Gold / Silver: Absent.
Crystal: One Mysticalman Eusine battle follows the Suicune scene.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: One TRAINER_MYSTERY_MAN_EUSINE battle follows the Suicune scene.
Integration decision: One shared story battle with separate source metadata; never duplicate it for Crystal and HGSS.

Gold / Silver: No dedicated route.
Crystal: Cianwood completion activates the Route 42 Suicune scene.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Cianwood completion clears the Route 42 Suicune hide flag and prepares the Route 42 scene.
Integration decision: Merge Cianwood→Route42 as a shared Crystal/HGSS transition.

Gold / Silver: No fixed route.
Crystal: Route 42 advances the Crystal chain toward Route 36 and ultimately the Crystal tower conclusion.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Route 42 clears the Vermilion Suicune hide flag, beginning the later Kanto continuation.
Integration decision: Fork only after the shared Route 42 waypoint: Crystal branch → Route36/tower; HGSS branch → Vermilion/Route14/Route25. Use one global caught state.

Gold / Silver: Chuck can be challenged while the player is in Cianwood; the SecretPotion quest does not require defeating him.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Chuck uses a separate Gym state; Cianwood Suicune and pharmacy scripts do not require Storm Badge.
Integration decision: Preserve independence between Chuck, Eusine, and SecretPotion.

Gold / Silver: Strength/boulder puzzle; Chuck performs his famous boulder-breaking feat before battle.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Gym is rebuilt around a waterfall/winch mechanism.
Integration decision: Preserve Chuck's GSC boulder feat as dialogue/animation, and add the HGSS waterfall/winch puzzle as an expanded map mechanic rather than replacing the character scene.

Gold / Silver: TM01 DynamicPunch.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: TM01 Focus Punch.
Integration decision: The item number collides while the move differs. Preserve the GSC TM01 record and add Gen IV TM01 Focus Punch under the expanded TM namespace/data model; never silently relabel the old TM.

Gold / Silver: Chuck's wife gives HM02 Fly after Storm Badge.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Cianwood city script gives ITEM_HM02 after the badge.
Integration decision: One shared HM02 Fly reward state.

Gold / Silver: The player may sail back manually; Chuck is not a prerequisite to heal Amphy.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: SecretPotion and Lighthouse scripts do not require Storm Badge.
Integration decision: Do not force Chuck before Jasmine. Fly is convenience, not a story gate.

Gold / Silver: SecretPotion is handed to Jasmine; Ampharos recovers and Jasmine leaves for the Gym.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Takes ITEM_SECRETPOTION, animates Ampharos recovery, advances VAR_SCENE_LIGHTHOUSE_JASMINE, and clears Jasmine's Gym hide flag.
Integration decision: Make this an atomic transaction: consume medicine → set Amphy healed → move Jasmine → enable Gym. On reload, no partial state is allowed.

Gold / Silver: Once Amphy is healed and Jasmine returns, her Gym can be challenged; Chuck victory is not required.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Jasmine Gym script checks Mineral Badge/reward state, not Storm Badge.
Integration decision: Preserve the flexible Chuck/Jasmine order.

Gold / Silver: Mineral Badge + TM23 Iron Tail.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Mineral Badge + ITEM_TM23.
Integration decision: Single shared reward state; no conflict.

Gold / Silver: Gen II permits substantial freedom among the post-Morty midgame leaders.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Morty/Chuck/Jasmine scripts update VAR_MIDGAME_BADGES and Rocket-takeover state instead of assuming one rigid leader order.
Integration decision: Model Rocket escalation from badge/progression facts, not a fixed Chuck→Jasmine→Pryce sequence.

Gold / Silver: No Safari Zone storyline in this area.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Baoba later phones that the Safari Zone has opened and directs the player through the cavern route from Cianwood.
Integration decision: Keep as an independent HGSS side-story state seeded on Route 39; implementation of Routes 47/48 and Safari Zone is deferred, not omitted.
